Account Manager Job at Dotts Media House




        
    

        
        Dotts Media House is Africa's leading digital marketing firm - using three arms - content, consulting and strategy - to create campaigns, movements & stories that inspire change and socio-economic development - helping our corporate, institutional and governance clients expand their reach across an increasingly progressive audience. We have led almost 8 years of impeccable digital marketing, public relations, influencer marketing, corporate communications, project management, crises / reputation management, and government relations experience. We have several national/global awards & recognitions for our work.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Lagos

Job Description


	Serve as the primary relationship manager for assigned advertisers and agencies.
	Onboard brands and agencies onto the platform.
	Understand clients’ campaign objectives, target audiences, budgets and deliverables.
	Review campaign briefs before they go live.
	Ensure campaigns are correctly structured and communicated to creators.
	Support advertisers in selecting suitable creators.
	Monitor campaign progress and deliverables.
	Coordinate communication between advertisers, creators and internal teams.
	Resolve campaign-related issues and escalations.
	Track campaign performance and provide clients with updates.
	Prepare campaign reports and performance summaries.
	Identify opportunities for clients to run additional campaigns.
	Maintain strong relationships with key clients.
	Gather client feedback and communicate product improvement opportunities.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Channel (Sales) Specialist",
  "description": "ITEL Energy is an energy solutions company committed to delivering reliable, innovative, and sustainable power solutions for homes, businesses, and communities. With a focus on quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, ITEL Energy provides energy products and services that support dependable power access and long-term energy transformation.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Channel (Sales) Specialist
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	ITEL Energy is seeking a proactive and results-driven Sales Specialist &mdash; Channel Distribution to support the growth and management of its distributor, dealer, reseller, and retail partner network. The role will focus on expanding market coverage, driving product sales, strengthening partner relationships, and ensuring effective product availability across assigned territories.
	The ideal candidate will have strong experience in channel sales, distributor management, and indirect sales, with the ability to support partner performance and execute market development initiatives.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and manage strong relationships with distributors, dealers, resellers, and retail partners.
	Identify, recruit, and onboard new channel partners to expand market reach.
	Support channel partners with product knowledge, sales tools, and promotional materials.
	Drive sell-in and sell-out activities to improve product movement across channels.
	Monitor partner performance against agreed sales targets and KPIs.
	Conduct regular partner visits and business reviews to identify growth opportunities.
	Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to ensure product availability and market support.
	Provide market intelligence on competitor activity, pricing trends, customer feedback, and territory opportunities.
	Support the execution of channel promotions, incentive programs, and brand visibility initiatives.
	Resolve partner-related issues, including pricing concerns, stock challenges, and customer escalations.
	Maintain accurate records of channel activities, sales performance, and partner updates using CRM tools.
	Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on channel performance and market activities.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, pricing guidelines, and channel agreements.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
	4&ndash;7 years of experience in channel sales, distributor management, indirect sales, or territory sales.
	Prior experience managing or supporting distributors, dealers, resellers, or retail partners is required.
	Strong understanding of channel sales operations and partner performance management.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
	Ability to conduct field visits and manage sales activities across assigned territories.
	Strong reporting, market intelligence, and sales tracking skills.
	Experience in energy products, consumer electronics, solar products, FMCG, telecoms, or related sectors is an added advantage.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and cover letter to: NGHR.TranESS@transsion.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Channel (Sales) Specialist Job at Itel Energy




        
    

        
        ITEL Energy is an energy solutions company committed to delivering reliable, innovative, and sustainable power solutions for homes, businesses, and communities. With a focus on quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, ITEL Energy provides energy products and services that support dependable power access and long-term energy transformation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Channel (Sales) Specialist
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	ITEL Energy is seeking a proactive and results-driven Sales Specialist — Channel Distribution to support the growth and management of its distributor, dealer, reseller, and retail partner network. The role will focus on expanding market coverage, driving product sales, strengthening partner relationships, and ensuring effective product availability across assigned territories.
	The ideal candidate will have strong experience in channel sales, distributor management, and indirect sales, with the ability to support partner performance and execute market development initiatives.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and manage strong relationships with distributors, dealers, resellers, and retail partners.
	Identify, recruit, and onboard new channel partners to expand market reach.
	Support channel partners with product knowledge, sales tools, and promotional materials.
	Drive sell-in and sell-out activities to improve product movement across channels.
	Monitor partner performance against agreed sales targets and KPIs.
	Conduct regular partner visits and business reviews to identify growth opportunities.
	Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to ensure product availability and market support.
	Provide market intelligence on competitor activity, pricing trends, customer feedback, and territory opportunities.
	Support the execution of channel promotions, incentive programs, and brand visibility initiatives.
	Resolve partner-related issues, including pricing concerns, stock challenges, and customer escalations.
	Maintain accurate records of channel activities, sales performance, and partner updates using CRM tools.
	Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on channel performance and market activities.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, pricing guidelines, and channel agreements.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
	4–7 years of experience in channel sales, distributor management, indirect sales, or territory sales.
	Prior experience managing or supporting distributors, dealers, resellers, or retail partners is required.
	Strong understanding of channel sales operations and partner performance management.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
	Ability to conduct field visits and manage sales activities across assigned territories.
	Strong reporting, market intelligence, and sales tracking skills.
	Experience in energy products, consumer electronics, solar products, FMCG, telecoms, or related sectors is an added advantage.


Method of Application

        Itel Energy is a renewable energy solutions company focused on providing reliable, affordable, and sustainable solar power solutions across Nigeria. As part of the itel ecosystem, Itel Energy leverages strong distribution networks and deep market reach to deliver innovative off-grid and hybrid solar solutions for homes, SMEs, and commercial customers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Warehouse Keeper

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT), Kano, Lagos, Oyo and Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are looking for a responsible and organized Warehouse Keeper to manage daily warehouse operations, maintain accurate inventory records, and ensure the safe storage and movement of products.


Key Responsibilities


	Receive, inspect, store, and issue products and materials.
	Maintain accurate records of all stock movements.
	Conduct regular stock counts and reconcile discrepancies.
	Monitor inventory levels and report shortages, damages, or losses.
	Ensure proper arrangement, labeling, and cleanliness of the warehouse.
	Coordinate with Logistics, Sales, Finance, and Operations teams on stock movement.
	Ensure compliance with warehouse and safety procedures.


Requirements


	OND/HND/Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
	2–3 years of experience in warehouse or inventory management.
	Good knowledge of inventory management and warehouse procedures.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or inventory management systems.
	Strong organizational, numerical, and record-keeping skills.
	Good communication skills and attention to detail.
